I'll search for information about this FedEx Express URL to help you.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>www.home.fedex.com/express FedEx Express shipping</query>

Based on my search, I can provide you with information about this URL and FedEx Express services.

The URL **www.home.fedex.com/express** appears to be related to FedEx's express shipping services, though the specific subdomain structure you mentioned (www.home.fedex.com) is not the standard current format that FedEx uses. FedEx's main website is typically accessed through **www.fedex.com**.

FedEx Express is one of FedEx's primary operating companies and offers:
- Time-definite domestic and international shipping
- Overnight delivery services (FedEx First Overnight, FedEx Priority Overnight, FedEx Standard Overnight)
- 2-day and 3-day shipping options
- International priority and economy services
- Freight services through FedEx Express Freight

For accessing FedEx Express services online, the current standard URLs are:
- **https://www.fedex.com** - Main FedEx website
- **https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/express.html** - FedEx Express shipping page

If you're trying to access specific FedEx Express tools or services, you may want to verify the exact URL, as the "home.fedex.com" subdomain format may be outdated or specific to certain regional or legacy systems.

1. https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/express.html
2. https://www.fedex.com
